dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: An outcome that will decide my future!

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: ...It's my application to remain in school after graduation.

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: I heard the competition to join the Akademiya has been growing in intensity. People are giving recommendations to Ms. Kemia every day. I wonder if I still have a chance...

dialogues.speaker: Dana
dialogues.text: No, I must stay confident. Based on the results of my final paper, I still have quite the advantage.
